prizeSub: for beating the Pokolenie Cudów team

steps.title: Sign up
steps.body: Create a HoopConnect account and back up your training — shooting sessions, strength work and stats will help you get ready for the match like a pro.

steps.title: Start a club
steps.body: The match is played 3-on-3. Start a club in the app and get at least 3 people on your team — or join an existing one and fill the missing spots.

steps.title: Play with us
steps.body: The match takes place June 4th at 4:20 PM on the court by Szkoła Podstawowa im. Białych Górników. Show up ready — Pokolenie Cudów is waiting.
